summary: Aegon Ltd launched a tender offer to repurchase five series of its outstanding subordinated notes for cash, up to approximately EUR 2.0B aggregate principal. Purchase prices are between 75.00% and 89.625% of par, depending on the series, with no stated premium. The board recommends the offers to manage leverage. The tender expires May 7, 2026, with settlement expected May 11, 2026. This is a debt liability management transaction (US equivalent: issuer tender offer). Watch final acceptance amounts and any tendering shortfall that could affect capital structure targets.
